products.body_html:

This structured black denim jacket features an asymmetric rhinestone design across one shoulder and sleeve, finished with warm contrast stitching and signature LIGHT detailing on the collar. A red LIGHT × NYFW logo is printed inside the neckline for a custom finish.

• Exclusive 1-of-1 design
• Black denim construction

• Signature LIGHT collar print

products.title: LIGHT CHAIN TEE
products.body_html:
The LIGHT Chain Long Sleeve combines bold faith with luxury streetwear. Crafted from heavyweight 7.5 oz, 100% USA cotton, it features an oversized fit and a detailed silver chain graphic with crosses, radiant stars, and the signature LIGHT emblem. The printed necklace effect creates the appearance of layered jewelry without needing accessories.

• Cream color
• Heavyweight 7.5 oz cotton
• Oversized streetwear fit
• Ribbed collar and cuffs
• Front chain-and-cross graphic
• Unisex design

The chain is a printed graphic and is not actual jewelry.

products.title: LIGHT CHAIN HOODIE
products.body_html:
LIGHT CHAIN HOODIE

Heavyweight garment-dyed hoodie featuring the signature LIGHT chain-and-cross graphic across the chest. Constructed from dense 13.5 oz cotton fleece for a structured, premium silhouette.

DETAILS

• 13.5 oz heavyweight fleece
• 100% USA cotton
• Garment-dyed black finish
• Relaxed, slightly oversized fit
• LIGHT chain-and-cross chest graphic
• Double-layer hood
• No drawcord
• Front pouch pocket
• Heavy ribbed cuffs and waistband
• Unisex

SIZE GUIDE

• Small — 21” chest / 27” length
• Medium — 23” chest / 28” length
• Large — 25” chest / 29” length
• XL — 27” chest / 29.5” length
• 2XL — 28” chest / 30” length

Chest measurements are taken laid flat. For a more oversized fit, size up.

CARE

Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Hang dry or tumble dry low. Do not bleach or iron directly over the graphic.

products.title: LIGHT4EVA Reflective Women’s Tee
products.body_html:
A clean, fitted essential designed to stand out when the light hits. The LIGHT4EVA Reflective Women’s Tee features our signature reflective logo on the chest and inner neckline, giving the shirt a sleek metallic finish that comes alive under flash and direct light.

Made with a smooth, lightweight feel and a flattering women’s fit, it’s built for everyday wear, styling, and movement.

Details: Reflective LIGHT4EVA front logo • Signature inner-neck logo • Lightweight, smooth fabric • Fitted women’s silhouette • Available in Black and White

LIGHT shines everywhere.

products.title: LIGHT 4EVA REFLECTIVE BAG
products.body_html: Built for everyday movement. The LIGHT 4EVA Bag features a lightweight, spacious design with a bold metallic reflective LIGHT 4EVA logo on the front. Its oversized silhouette makes it easy to carry your daily essentials while keeping a clean, standout look.
